name: starflow-launch
title: Starflow launch page
description: Astra-style dark launch page or hero: a bundled three.js galaxy that tilts, scatters into side rails and re-forms into a cursor, a knot, or your own logo path as the reader scrolls. Ships the Starflow engine, a wired page skeleton, and the openai-astra DESIGN.md.

description_i18n.en: Astra-style dark launch page or hero: a bundled three.js galaxy that tilts, scatters into side rails and re-forms into a cursor, a knot, or your own logo path as the reader scrolls. Ships the Starflow engine, a wired page skeleton, and the openai-astra DESIGN.md.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Astra 风格的暗色发布页或首屏：自带 three.js 星系，随滚动翻转、散成两侧星轨、再聚成光标、结或你自己的 logo 路径。附带星流引擎、接好线的页面骨架和 openai-astra DESIGN.md。

query.en: Make a launch page for our new model Nova 2 in the Astra style: galaxy hero, three story sections, the stars should form a cursor and then our logo.
query.zh-CN: 用 Astra 风格给我们的新模型 Nova 2 做一个发布页：星系首屏、三段故事，星星先聚成光标，再聚成我们的 logo。

origin.name: Starflow
origin.reference: https://github.com/Win-Hao/starflow (MIT). A three.js re-implementation of the particle choreography on the GPT-6 Astra launch page; the engine bundle in assets/ is built from it.

provenance.transformation: Original skill. The page skeletons (assets/template.html, assets/hero.html) wire the engine's public API (createAstraScene, setSource, setScroll, createShapeSamples) to DOM measurements; the design system (design-systems/openai-astra) is an independent distillation of the launch page's public CSS. No fonts, logos, images, or scripts from openai.com are included.
